scope: Current market-intelligence benchmark for Romanian EU-funding consultancy, funding-discovery products, B2B prospecting/ABM and professional-services conversion UX.

method.principle: Primary/product sources are used for product behavior; official sources are used for regulatory/trust constraints; observations are separated from EUCONS product decisions.
method.copy_policy: Patterns may inform capability design; competitor wording, claims and design are not copied.
method.privacy_policy: Organization-level public data and business-context signals are preferred. Contact-level enrichment, visitor deanonymization and autonomous outreach are not adopted as default EUCONS requirements.

observed_patterns: Opportunity-led homepage with currently promoted funding programmes and repeated consultation CTAs.
Broad end-to-end service scope spanning funding access and implementation-adjacent services.
Commercial risk-reversal/guarantee framing is prominent.
benchmark.eucons_implication: Match the immediacy of opportunity-led entry points, but differentiate through provenance, explicit uncertainty and evidence-backed proof rather than aggressive success/guarantee claims.

observed_patterns: Fast eligibility-check positioning is a primary acquisition route.
Programme-specific pages create search/discovery surfaces.
The service story covers identification, application, implementation and monitoring.
benchmark.eucons_implication: Eligibility and programme intent should be first-class entry journeys, but EUCONS should return an explainable preliminary fit with unknowns rather than a binary marketing promise.

observed_patterns: Detailed eligibility form captures organization, financial, project, investment and location data.
Marketing opt-in is separated from the project-evaluation processing acknowledgement.
benchmark.eucons_implication: The data fields are commercially relevant, but EUCONS should progressively capture them to reduce form friction and preserve data minimization.

observed_patterns: Fresh funding news/opportunity pages are directly tied to consultancy conversion.
A virtual assistant/account route is promoted to help users find suitable funding.
Official-source references and downloadable source documents are surfaced in opportunity content.
benchmark.eucons_implication: Funding intelligence should be a live acquisition surface, not a static service page; provenance and document-level evidence should remain visible.

observed_patterns: Opportunity catalogue supports category filtering and deadline-oriented scanning.
Alerts/newsletter are explicit retention mechanisms.
benchmark.eucons_implication: Once PARTENER projections are live, EUCONS needs useful browsing/filtering and saved-interest/alert concepts rather than an empty or purely narrative funding page.

observed_patterns: AFIR provides an orientative consultant directory to facilitate identification/contact.
AFIR explicitly states that inclusion is not accreditation or ranking.
benchmark.eucons_implication: EUCONS must not imply official accreditation. Official directories may be a discovery channel; trust should come from evidence, service clarity and verified case history.

observed_patterns: Guided natural-language project description replaces keyword-heavy setup in the new Discover experience.
Smart matching, automatically refreshed matches and tracking reduce repeated search work.
Funder context and historical giving are used to improve prioritization.
Application drafting is connected to accumulated institutional history rather than being a disconnected generator.
benchmark.eucons_implication: Ask for project context conversationally, maintain an opportunity/service tracker and reuse verified organizational/project history when preparing next actions.

observed_patterns: Advanced filters coexist with personalized recommendations.
Saved searches, alerts, favourites/lists and change monitoring reduce repeated search effort.
Pre-solicitations and funded awards provide strategic early/retrospective intelligence beyond open calls.
benchmark.eucons_implication: EUCONS/PARTENER should eventually support watchlists and early signals; Client Finder can use award/project history as an organization-level prospecting signal when legally/publicly available.

observed_patterns: Funding discovery is packaged with adjacent business-support resources.
The proposition is oriented to startups, scaleups, SMEs and innovation intermediaries.
benchmark.eucons_implication: EUCONS can bundle funding fit with implementation/training/operational support, but service recommendations must stay specific to verified needs.

benchmark.category: Official EU direct-funding and partner search
observed_patterns: Partner Search exposes organizations with past funded-project history and organization profiles.
Search by area/geography/funding context and topic-specific partner interest supports proactive consortium discovery.
benchmark.eucons_implication: For direct-Brussels services, organization/project history is a legitimate high-value prospect/partner signal when taken from official portal records.

observed_patterns: Signals are treated as standing monitors rather than static lists.
Multi-signal stacking separates weak coincidence from stronger timing.
Funding, hiring, job postings, news, website intent and custom public signals can be enriched before an action is recommended.
Signals are mapped to plays and urgency before routing.
benchmark.eucons_implication: Client Finder should be designed as signal -> evidence -> score -> service/play -> human-gated next action, with signal expiry and multi-signal support.

observed_patterns: Buying intent is combined with ideal-customer-profile filtering and prioritization.
Intent is multi-source and time-sensitive; alerts support speed-to-action.
Website-visitor identification is integrated with account/contact data and downstream engagement.
benchmark.eucons_implication: Adopt signal scoring/prioritization concepts, but do not copy contact-level deanonymization or autonomous sequencing because EUCONS has stricter GDPR/minimization/human-approval requirements.

market_findings.finding: Eligibility checking is a commodity acquisition pattern in Romanian consultancy; a simple eligibility CTA is not a sufficient differentiator.
market_findings.product_response: Return an explainable fit assessment with evidence, unknowns, conflicts, next documents to verify and relevant service/opportunity links.

market_findings.finding: Opportunity-led pages and alerts are expected discovery/retention mechanisms.
market_findings.product_response: Turn verified PARTENER projections into browsable, filterable, freshness-aware EUCONS acquisition surfaces and later saved-interest alerts.

market_findings.finding: Consultancy competitors emphasize end-to-end service breadth, but public proof quality is uneven and often claim-heavy.
market_findings.product_response: Use provenance-addressable case evidence and project-role history as the trust moat; never compete on unsupported success percentages or guarantees.

market_findings.finding: Modern grant products shift from keyword search to contextual project profiles and continuously refreshed matching.
market_findings.product_response: Progressive conversational intake plus a persistent organization/project profile should feed both inbound matching and future opportunity updates.

market_findings.finding: Modern B2B prospecting products prioritize trigger signals and timing, not static company lists.
market_findings.product_response: Client Finder should monitor evidence-backed organization-level signals with recency/expiry and multi-signal scoring.

market_findings.finding: Signal value increases when it is attached to a specific play and enough context to act without repeating research.
market_findings.product_response: Every prospect record should carry why-now evidence, candidate service, recommended next action, missing verification and an outreach/call brief draft.

market_findings.finding: Contact-level enrichment and website deanonymization are commercially common but create privacy/compliance complexity for an EU professional-services firm.
market_findings.product_response: Start organization-first. Person/contact enrichment remains deferred and compliance-gated; no autonomous sending.

market_findings.finding: Implementation, reporting, procurement and recovery needs create value after funding is won, while much market messaging remains acquisition-centric.
market_findings.product_response: Treat awarded-project and implementation-stage signals as a separate high-value prospect lane.

ranked_capability_backlog.acceptance: Canonical signal types define source class, evidence fields, recency/expiry, supported service/play, confidence contribution and disallowed inferences.
Organization record contains stable identity, public-source provenance, signals, candidate services, confidence, unknown/conflict fields, expiry, privacy/publicability class and audit history.
Deterministic score explains each contribution, penalizes stale/weak/conflicting evidence and never treats score as proven eligibility.
Output separates FACT/INFERENCE/UNKNOWN/CONFLICT and explains fit, missing checks, candidate service and next-best-action.

Pack contains organization summary, why-now evidence, recommended service, opportunity links, unknowns, discovery questions, call brief and outreach draft; external contact remains READY_FOR_APPROVAL.
First step can start with organization/project intent; later fields appear only when relevant; consent/marketing opt-in remain separate; preliminary result is explainable and non-binding.
Current verified opportunities can be filtered by audience/theme/geography/status; stale/unknown facts remain explicit; watch/alert contract is consent-aware.
Signals can identify organization-level awarded/project-stage evidence and map to implementation/reporting/procurement/recovery services without inferring non-public project problems.
Each priority journey can surface only role/result evidence relevant to that service and publicability class.
Only implemented after documented lawful-basis/provider review, with organization-level minimization, retention limits and no contact-level deanonymization by default.

anti_patterns: Do not publish or optimize around unsupported success-rate percentages, guaranteed funding language or official-accreditation implications.
Do not build a static scraped-company database without trigger evidence and expiry.
Do not treat a prospect score as eligibility.
Do not require a long all-at-once evaluation form when fields can be progressively requested.
Do not adopt contact-level website deanonymization, private-person enrichment or autonomous sequencing as default product behavior.
Do not duplicate PARTENER acquisition or opportunity truth logic inside EUCONS.

decision.product_strategy: Build Client Finder organization-first and signal-driven, reusing verified PARTENER/opportunity matching and human-gated outreach. Differentiate the public site with explainable fit, evidence-adjacent trust and post-award implementation/recovery journeys.

next_unit.description: Build the customer/demand model: segment x job-to-be-done x trigger x service x evidence-needed x acquisition-channel matrix, grounded in Romanian market/public data and observed demand patterns.
